Description EN: Effetto Larsen is an organisation that brings together performing arts, scientific research, and experiential learning to design transformative pathways for communities, institutions, arts festivals, and companies. The Effetto Larsen method develops through formats that originate as workshops open to the public and that, after years of field research, evolve into full-fledged participatory installations and performances that they organise around the world.

EIT Culture & Creativity is the institutional partnership dedicated to helping European cultural and creative sectors and industries (CCSI) to become more sustainable, resilient and competitive. It provides funding, knowledge and tailored support to the ecosystem through innovation, education and business creation. Its Transformation and NEB Area strengthens collaborative, regenerative innovation ecosystems, using culture and creativity to drive systemic change across the lived environment.

Bernd Resch is a Professor of GeoSocial AI at IT:U and a Visiting Scholar at Harvard University’s Center for Geographic Analysis. His research interest revolves around understanding cities as complex systems through analyzing a variety of digital data sources. The focus is on developing machine learning algorithms to analyze such human-generated data as social media posts, mobile phone data and physiological measurements from wearable sensors.
Description DE: Bernd Resch ist Professor für GeoSocial AI an der IT:U und Visiting Scholar am Center for Geographic Analysis der Harvard University. In seiner Forschung untersucht er Städte als komplexe Systeme durch die Analyse vielfältiger digitaler Datenquellen. Im Zentrum steht die Entwicklung von Machine-Learning-Algorithmen, um menschlich erzeugte Daten wie Social-Media-Beiträge, Mobilfunkdaten und physiologische Messdaten von Wearable-Sensoren zu analysieren.

Description EN: As an actor and choreographer, Lukas Strasser combines the perspectives of performance, movement and cinematic storytelling. His work explores the interplay of body, space and camera. He is also the director of drehübung wien, an Austrian training platform for professional filmmakers, where he develops and organizes practical workshops and exchange formats that foster interdisciplinary collaboration within the film industry.
Description DE: Als Schauspieler und Choreograf verbindet Lukas Strasser die Perspektiven von Performance, Bewegung und filmischem Erzählen. In seiner Arbeit beschäftigt er sich mit dem Zusammenspiel von Körper, Raum und Kamera. Zudem ist er Leiter der drehübung wien, einer österreichischen Weiterbildungsplattform für professionelle Filmschaffende. Er entwickelt dort praxisnahe Workshops und Austauschformate, die den gewerkeübergreifenden Dialog und die Zusammenarbeit innerhalb der Filmbranche fördern.

Description EN: drehübung wien is an Austrian training platform for professional filmmakers. Since 2016, it has created spaces for practice-oriented learning, cross-departmental exchange and new impulses for the film industry. Through workshops, coaching sessions and trainings with national and international experts, it fosters collaboration between different departments and supports filmmakers in developing their skills and exploring new perspectives.
Description DE: Die drehübung wien ist eine österreichische Weiterbildungsplattform für professionelle Filmschaffende. Seit 2016 schafft sie Räume für praxisnahes Lernen, gewerkeübergreifenden Austausch und neue Impulse für die Filmbranche. Mit Workshops, Coachings und Trainings mit nationalen und internationalen Expert*innen fördert sie die Zusammenarbeit zwischen unterschiedlichen Departments und unterstützt Filmschaffende dabei, ihre Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln und neue Perspektiven zu entdecken.

Description EN: Interdisciplinary Transformation University (IT:U) is one of the first public universities in Europe dedicated to digitalization and digital transformation. On our campus in Linz, Austria, we offer our students a project-based and inclusive approach to technical education.
Description DE: Die Interdisciplinary Transformation University (IT:U) ist eine der ersten öffentlichen Universitäten Europas, die sich auf Digitalisierung und digitale Transformation spezialisiert. Auf unserem Campus in Linz, Österreich, bieten wir unseren Studierenden einen projektbasierten und inklusiven Zugang zur technischen Ausbildung.

Description EN: Gerfried Stocker is a media artist and telecommunications engineer. Since 1995, Gerfried Stocker has served as artistic director and managing director of Ars Electronica. Working with a small team of artists and technicians, he developed the exhibition strategies for the Ars Electronica Center in 1995–96 and oversaw the establishment of a research and development department, the Ars Electronica Futurelab. Under his leadership, the program for international Ars Electronica exhibitions was established starting in 2004; planning and a repositioning of the content for the Ars Electronica Center—which underwent structural expansion in 2009—began in 2005; the expansion of the Ars Electronica Festival starting in 2015, and the large-scale thematic and interior redesign of the Ars Electronica Center in 2019. Stocker advises numerous companies and institutions in the fields of creativity and innovation management and is a guest speaker at international conferences and universities. In 2019, he received an honorary doctorate from Aalto University in Finland.
Description DE: Gerfried Stocker ist Medienkünstler und Ingenieur der Nachrichtentechnik. Seit 1995 ist er künstlerischer Leiter und Geschäftsführer von Ars Electronica. Mit einem kleinen Team von Künstler*innen und Techniker*innen entwickelte er 1995/96 die Ausstellungsstrategien des Ars Electronica Center und betrieb den Aufbau einer Forschungs- und Entwicklungsabteilung, dem Ars Electronica Futurelab. Unter seiner Führung erfolgte ab 2004 der Aufbau des Programms für internationale Ars Electronica Ausstellungen, ab 2005 die Planung und inhaltliche Neupositionierung für das 2009 baulich erweiterte Ars Electronica Center, ab 2015 die Expansion des Ars Electronica Festival und im Jahr 2019 die großangelegte thematische und innenarchitektonische Neugestaltung des Ars Electronica Center. Stocker berät zahlreiche Unternehmen und Institutionen in den Bereichen Kreativität und Innovationsmanagement, ist Gastredner auf internationalen Konferenzen und Universitäten. 2019 erhielt er ein Ehrendoktorat der Aalto University, Finnland.

Description EN: The Clinical Research Institute for Medical Artificial Intelligence (KFI MAI) brings together physicians, data and natural scientists, engineers and translational researchers to build a bridge between cutting-edge AI, medical research and real-world patient care. The shared goal is to develop innovative models and algorithms and translate them into clinically relevant solutions—accelerating diagnoses, personalizing therapies and improving treatment outcomes—while creating a collaborative environment in which diverse expertise in this field drives impactful, patient-centered research.
Description DE: Das Klinische Forschungsinstitut Medical Artificial Intelligence (KFI MAI) vereint Ärzt*innen, Daten- und Naturwissenschaftler*innen, Ingenieur*innen und translationale Forscher*innen, um eine Brücke zwischen modernster KI, medizinischer Forschung und der realen Patientenversorgung zu schlagen. Das gemeinsame Ziel ist es, innovative Modelle und Algorithmen zu entwickeln und in klinisch relevante Lösungen zu überführen – Diagnosen zu beschleunigen, Therapien zu personalisieren und Behandlungsergebnisse zu verbessern – und dabei ein kollaboratives Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem vielfältige Expertise in diesem Feld eine wirkungsvolle, patientenorientierte Forschung vorantreibt.

Description EN: Friedrich Bachinger is a Senior Developer & Researcher at the Ars Electronica Futurelab. He develops interactive and immersive systems at the intersection of research and software engineering. His expertise spans Unreal Engine, real-time rendering, human-computer interaction, full-stack development and software and system architecture—from early prototypes to robust, connected applications and installations.
Description DE: Friedrich Bachinger ist Senior Developer & Researcher am Ars Electronica Futurelab. Er entwickelt interaktive und immersive Systeme an der Schnittstelle zwischen Forschung und Softwareentwicklung. Seine Fachkenntnisse umfassen die Unreal Engine, Echtzeit-Rendering, Mensch-Computer-Interaktion, Full-Stack-Entwicklung sowie Software- und Systemarchitektur – von frühen Prototypen bis hin zu robusten, vernetzten Anwendungen und Installationen.

Description EN: Alexander Boboschewski is a Director of Photography, cinematographer and film producer from Vienna. Since 1986, he has been telling stories through moving images—for film, television and international productions. His visual language combines intuition and precision, light and movement, emotion and technique. Whether feature film, documentary or live production: for him, it always comes down to the image that brings a story to life.
Description DE: Alexander Boboschewski ist Director of Photography, Kameramann und Filmproduzent aus Wien. Seit 1986 erzählt er Geschichten in bewegten Bildern – für Film, Fernsehen und internationale Produktionen. Seine Bildsprache verbindet Intuition und Präzision, Licht und Bewegung, Emotion und Technik. Ob Spielfilm, Dokumentation oder Liveproduktion: Im Mittelpunkt steht für ihn immer das Bild, das eine Geschichte fühlbar macht.

Description EN: Rasa Bocyte (she/her) is a cultural heritage professional with a passion for forging cross-sectoral connections underpinned by creative and critical approaches. She advocates for sustainable innovation practices that prioritise public values, slowness and care. In her current role at the Netherlands Institute for Sound & Vision, she examines hype in narratives surrounding emerging technologies and creates room for more meaningful, playful and critical engagement with digital tech.

George Oates is a software designer and entrepreneur who specializes in technology and cultural heritage. She is best known as the first designer of Flickr and creator of Flickr Commons, which made photography collections from public institutions more accessible online. After roles at Flickr, the Internet Archive and Stamen Design, she focused on digital preservation. In 2022, she founded the Flickr Foundation and co-founded Deep Keep to preserve digital cultural records.

Kerstin Blätterbinder studied Media Technology and Design at the University of Applied Sciences Upper Austria, where she also completed her Master’s in Digital Arts. Since 2019, she has been working as a Media Designer at the Ars Electronica Futurelab. There, she works on the conception and implementation of a wide range of media projects, with a particular focus on interactive installations. Her work combines animation and 3D design with the creation of user-centered interfaces and experiences.
Description DE: Kerstin Blätterbinder studierte Medientechnik und -design an der Fachhochschule Oberösterreich in Hagenberg und absolvierte dort den Master Digital Arts. Seit 2019 ist Kerstin als Mediendesignerin im Ars Electronica Futurelab tätig. Dort arbeitet sie an der Konzeption und Umsetzung vielfältiger Medienprojekte, insbesondere im Bereich interaktiver Installationen. Ihre Arbeit vereint die Bereiche Animation und 3D Design mit der Gestaltung nutzerzentrierter User Interfaces und Experiences.

Description EN: Freddie Hong is a London-based visual artist and researcher who explores how emerging technologies shape our relationships with the physical world and society. Through interactive installations, he invites audiences to reflect on how intelligent systems influence perception, behavior and social interaction. He holds a PhD in Human-Computer Interaction and also conducts engineering research in HCI and robotics.
Description DE: Freddie Hong ist ein in London ansässiger bildender Künstler und Forscher, der sich damit beschäftigt, wie neue Technologien unsere Beziehungen zur physischen Welt und zur Gesellschaft prägen. Mit interaktiven Installationen lädt er das Publikum dazu ein, darüber nachzudenken, wie intelligente Systeme Wahrnehmung, Verhalten und soziale Interaktion beeinflussen. Er hat im Bereich Mensch-Computer-Interaktion promoviert und betreibt zudem ingenieurwissenschaftliche Forschung in den Bereichen HCI und Robotik.

Description EN: Jan Zuiderveld is an artist and researcher creating performative installations in which intelligent systems take on social roles through physical objects. Becoming participants in systems they expect to control, visitors find themselves having to persuade, contribute, respond or adapt. Through these encounters, he aims to make the psychological and societal effects of today’s technology tangible.
Description DE: Jan Zuiderveld ist Künstler und Forscher und schafft performative Installationen, in denen intelligente Systeme durch physische Objekte soziale Rollen übernehmen. Besucher*innen werden zu Teilnehmenden in Systemen, die sie zu kontrollieren glaubten – stattdessen müssen sie überzeugen, zusammenarbeiten, antworten oder sich anpassen. Durch diese Begegnungen möchte er die psychologischen und gesellschaftlichen Auswirkungen aktueller Technologie greifbar machen.

Description EN: Nikolaus Sabathiel is a Technical Project Manager at FreshFX Media in Salzburg, working at the intersection of AI, immersive media and interactive experiences. With a background in theoretical and computational physics, he develops and coordinates projects involving real-time AI avatars, XR and digital storytelling. He also lectured on AI in Game Development and physics-based simulations at Salzburg University of Applied Sciences.
Description DE: Nikolaus Sabathiel ist Technical Project Manager bei FreshFX Media in Salzburg und arbeitet an der Schnittstelle von KI, immersiven Medien und interaktiven Erlebnissen. Mit einem Hintergrund in theoretischer und computergestützter Physik entwickelt und koordiniert er Projekte rund um Echtzeit-KI-Avatare, XR und digitales Storytelling. Zudem war er als Lehrender für AI in Game Development und physikbasierte Simulationen an der FH Salzburg tätig.

Description EN:
Founded in 2004, the Computer History Museum Slovenia (Računalniški muzej) is a non-profit dedicated to developing the digital society and protecting cultural heritage. It is fully devoted to collecting, preserving, researching, and presenting the heritage of the digital age. Its collection spans over 8,000 artifacts, from analogue machines to AI, covering industrial and home computing as well as games.
As a UNESCO Software Heritage Foundation Ambassador, the museum is especially committed to preserving the intangible heritage of software programming. It is also a registered volunteer organization, promoting inclusion, diversity, and community engagement.bLocated in a 700m² three-story building in one of Ljubljana's most vibrant neighborhoods, the museum welcomes visitors daily from across Slovenia and abroad. Its programs include school visits, educator training, family activities, coding classes, meetups, and special events. The museum serves as a meeting point for the broader tech community—from open-source enthusiasts to commercial IT specialists, from beginners to experts—and is known for the strong intergenerational exchange it fosters. Beyond its own walls, the museum actively supports digital literacy initiatives, digital cultural development in other organizations through knowledge-sharing partnerships, consulting on digitization and archiving practices, and hands-on training in preserving digital heritage. It shares expertise in curating and cataloguing digital collections, advises cultural institutions on adapting to the digital age, and collaborates on joint projects that extend best practices in digital preservation internationally.

Maria Mayr works at Ars Electronica Futurelab in the field of People & Culture, where she focuses on collaborative work processes, employee profile development and training and education measures. Her focus is on the joint development of structures that enable reflective working methods and promote creativity for future-oriented collaboration.
Description DE: Maria Mayr arbeitet im Ars Electronica Futurelab im Bereich People & Culture, wo sie sich mit kollaborativen Arbeitsprozessen, der Profilentwicklung der Mitarbeiter*innen sowie Aus- und Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen beschäftigt. Der Fokus liegt auf der gemeinsamen Entwicklung von Strukturen, die eine reflektierte Arbeitsweise ermöglichen und Kreativität fördern – für eine zukunftsorientierte Zusammenarbeit.

Description EN:
Timid Robot is the Director of Technology at Creative Commons (CC). They joined CC in 2018 and are delighted to champion open content as a powerful tool for achieving human rights and sustainability. They bring over 20 years of professional experience empowering others through technology and digital infrastructure.

Timid Robot lives in Malta with their partner and two polydactyl cats. They love cats, free/libre and open source software, systems and giving back to the communities around them.

Alexandra Burgos-Thorsen is a landscape architect, artist and researcher from the US/Chile/Honduras, based in Copenhagen. Rooted in decolonial and multispecies thinking, she treats landscapes as living archives of memory, power and possible futures, proposing nature-based solutions as acts of care oriented toward many forms of life. She holds a lecturer position at the University of Copenhagen and serves as a Living Labs research assistant at the Green Solutions Centre.
Description DE: Alexandra Burgos-Thorsen ist Landschaftsarchitektin, Künstlerin und Forscherin aus den USA/Chile/Honduras mit Sitz in Kopenhagen. Verwurzelt in dekolonialem und mehr-als-menschlichem Denken, begreift sie Landschaften als lebendige Archive von Erinnerung, Macht und möglichen Zukünften und schlägt naturbasierte Lösungen als Akte der Fürsorge vor, die sich an vielfältigen Lebensformen orientieren. Sie ist Lektorin an der University of Copenhagen und arbeitet als Living-Labs-Forschungsassistentin am Green Solutions Centre.

Description EN: Ludovica Arci is an Immersive Executive Producer, Co-Founder of SARAVÁ, a studio crafting award-winning cinematic, immersive experiences that reimagine cultural heritage for contemporary audiences. Its work includes the largest immersive exhibition on India, Shiva Immersive and projects for Osaka Expo and the Venice Biennale. She is also aAdvisor for Way Experience, a leading VR studio in edutainment. Her career spans global platforms such as Design Week, Art Basel, NFT Paris and Asia Now.
Description DE: Ludovica Arci ist Immsive Executive Producer und Mitbegründerin von SARAVÁ, einem Studio, das preisgekrönte cineastische, immersive Erlebnisse schafft, die das kulturelle Erbe für ein zeitgenössisches Publikum neu interpretieren. Zu den Arbeiten des Studios zählen die größte immersive Ausstellung über Indien, Shiva Immersive, sowie Projekte für die Expo in Osaka und die Biennale in Venedig. Außerdem ist sie Beraterin bei Way Experience, einem führenden VR-Studio im Bereich Edutainment. Ihre Karriere erstreckt sich über globale Plattformen wie die Design Week, die Art Basel, die NFT Paris und Asia Now.

Description EN: Janja studied Human Geography in Slovenia and Austria, focusing on the relationship between people, places and cultures. As a qualified trainer in adult education and a business coach, she also works as an external lecturer at a university of applied sciences, where she accompanies students as a project coach and, within a European alliance, guides interdisciplinary student teams through Design Thinking processes.
Description DE: Janja studierte Humangeographie in Slowenien und Österreich mit Fokus auf die Beziehung zwischen Menschen, Orten und Kulturen. Als geprüfte Trainerin in der Erwachsenenbildung und Business-Coach arbeitet sie zudem als externe Lehrbeauftragte an einer Fachhochschule, wo sie Studierende als Projektcoach begleitet und im Rahmen einer europäischen Hochschulallianz interdisziplinäre studentische Teams durch Design-Thinking-Prozesse führt.

Description EN: Marlene Jungreithmayr is a student researcher at the Geosocial AI group at IT:U. She holds a bachelor’s degree in Geography and is currently studying her master’s in Geoinformatics at the University of Salzburg. She is working on the Climate Agents Project and designs and holds workshops.
Description DE: Marlene Jungreithmayr ist studentische Mitarbeiterin in der Forschungsgruppe Geosocial AI an der IT:U. Sie hat einen Bachelorabschluss in Geographie und studiert derzeit im Master Geoinformatik an der Universität Salzburg. Sie arbeitet am Climate Agents Project mit und konzipiert und leitet Workshops.

Description EN: Juergen Hagler is an academic researcher, artist, and curator specializing in animation, media art, and interactive art. He is Professor of Animation and Media Studies and Head of Digital Arts at the University of Applied Sciences Upper Austria. His work bridges artistic research, emerging technologies, and curatorial practice.
Description DE: Jürgen Hagler ist ein akademischer Forscher, Künstler und Kurator mit den Schwerpunkten Animation, Medienkunst und interaktive Kunst. Er ist Professor für Animation und Media Studies sowie Leiter des Bereichs Digital Arts an der Fachhochschule Oberösterreich. Seine Arbeit verbindet künstlerische Forschung, neue Technologien und kuratorische Praxis.

Description EN: Nils Gallist is a researcher and media artist focusing on interactive media, games, and immersive experiences. His work combines artistic practice, technological experimentation and research into playful forms of interaction.
Description DE: Nils Gallist ist Forscher und Medienkünstler mit den Schwerpunkten interaktive Medien, Games und immersive Erlebnisse. Seine Arbeit verbindet künstlerische Praxis, technologische Experimente und die Erforschung spielerischer Formen der Interaktion.

Description EN: Celine Pham is an artist and researcher working at the intersection of animation, generative AI and digital art. Her practice explores AI-assisted creative processes, experimental animation and new approaches to cultural heritage.
Description DE: Celine Pham ist Künstlerin und Forscherin an der Schnittstelle von Animation, generativer KI und digitaler Kunst. Ihre künstlerische Praxis beschäftigt sich mit KI-gestützten kreativen Prozessen, experimenteller Animation und neuen Ansätzen im Umgang mit kulturellem Erbe.

Description EN: Kyoko Kunoh is an artist and ambassador of Ars Electronica. She has created numerous art works in the field of interactive art, and works in a wide range of fields such as directing in the public and commercial space, designing exhibit products and being part of joint projects with companies and universities. Her projects have been featured in many different international locations including Ars Electronica (Austria), SIGGRAPH (USA), Centre Pompidou (France) and Japan Media Arts Festival (Japan).
Description DE: Kyoko Kunoh ist Künstlerin und Ars Electronica Ambassador. Sie hat zahlreiche Kunstwerke im Bereich der interaktiven Kunst geschaffen und ist in einer Vielzahl von Bereichen tätig, darunter die Inszenierung im öffentlichen und kommerziellen Raum, die Gestaltung von Ausstellungsprodukten sowie die Mitarbeit an Gemeinschaftsprojekten mit Unternehmen und Universitäten. Ihre Projekte wurden an verschiedensten internationalen Orten präsentiert, darunter bei der Ars Electronica (Österreich), der SIGGRAPH (USA), im Centre Pompidou (Frankreich) und beim Japan Media Arts Festival (Japan).

Description EN: Patrick Berger, MA, is a lead designer and artist at Ars Electronica Futurelab in Linz, working at the intersection of art, technology and immersive spaces. His practice spans virtual environments, 3D, animation, realtime and VFX, with a focus on creating interactive, embodied experiences. His work includes international drone and robot swarm performances, and Converge 2, an immersive multiplayer experience for Deep Space 8K exploring collaboration through avatars, movement and voice.
Description DE: Patrick Berger, MA, ist Lead Designer und Artist am Ars Electronica Futurelab in Linz und arbeitet an der Schnittstelle von Kunst, Technologie und immersiven Räumen. Seine Arbeit umfasst virtuelle Umgebungen, 3D, Animation, Echtzeit- und VFX-Techniken, wobei der Schwerpunkt auf der Schaffung interaktiver, körperlich erlebbarer Erfahrungen liegt. Zu seinen Arbeiten zählen internationale Drohnen- und Roboterschwarm-Performances sowie Converge 2, ein immersives Multiplayer-Erlebnis für den Deep Space 8K, das die Zusammenarbeit durch Avatare, Bewegung und Stimme erforscht.

Description EN: Merve Sahin is an architect, researcher and artist based in Vienna. Her practice is cantered on immersive media environments and speculative design. Through transmedia installations and real-time 3D environments, she explores how digital technologies shape the way we experience and understand urban spaces. Her work expands the visual language of architectural representation to reveal the ecological, cultural, political and intangible dimensions of cities.
Description DE: Merve Sahin ist Architektin, Forscherin und Künstlerin und lebt in Wien. Im Mittelpunkt ihrer Arbeit stehen immersive Medienumgebungen und spekulatives Design. Anhand von transmedialen Installationen und Echtzeit-3D-Umgebungen untersucht sie, wie digitale Technologien die Art und Weise prägen, wie wir städtische Räume erleben und verstehen. Ihre Arbeit erweitert die Bildsprache der architektonischen Darstellung, um die ökologischen, kulturellen, politischen und immateriellen Dimensionen von Städten sichtbar zu machen.

Description EN: Takuma Suzuki is a data scientist at Toyota Motor Corporation’s Advanced Data Science Management Division and a researcher in residence at Ars Electronica Futurelab. As a project manager and AI engineer for the Future Humanity Project, he explores how data science, art thinking and future-oriented research can be combined to develop new frameworks for innovation and human-centered value creation.
Description DE: Takuma Suzuki ist Data Scientist der Advanced Data Science Management Division der Toyota Motor Corporation und Researcher in Residence am Ars Electronica Futurelab. Als Projektleiter und KI-Ingenieur für das Future Humanity Project untersucht er, wie Data Science, künstlerisches Denken und zukunftsorientierte Forschung kombiniert werden können, um neue Rahmenbedingungen für Innovation und eine menschenzentrierte Wertschöpfung zu entwickeln.

Description EN: Isabel Linzer is an elections and democracy policy analyst at the Center for Democracy & Technology, where her portfolio includes information resilience, political influencers on social media and generative AI and elections. Isabel has previously worked across international human rights and democracy issues at Freedom House, UN OHCHR and the National Democratic Institute. She holds a Masters in Public Policy from Yale and a Bachelor of Arts in Government and French from Wesleyan University.

Seila Fernández Arconada is a multidisciplinary artist-researcher focusing on socio ecological uncertainties, from climatic shifts to societal disputes in bodies of water. She holds a vast international experience with numerous transdisciplinary workshops, exhibitions and publications. Currently, she leads O Fio da Água: Embracing Water’s Flow for Resilient Futures (Portugal) selected by STARTS AQUA MOTION in response to the challenge Moving Waters – Reimagining Flood Resilience, as well as Dnipro River, Ecosocial belonging in Wartime (Ukraine), among others.

Before joining the National Defence Academy of the Austrian Armed Forces, Gressel served as a Senior Policy Fellow at the ECFR Berlin Office from 2014 to 2024.
From 2003 to 2014 he served in the Bureau for Security Policy of the Austrian MoD, prior to his academic career in the Austrian Armed Forces.
Gustav earned a PhD in Strategic Studies at the Faculty of Military Sciences at the National University of Public Service, Budapest and a Master Degree in political science at Salzburg University.

Ioana Vreme Moser is a Romanian sound artist interested in hardware electronics, speculative research and tactile experimentation. In her practice, she uses rough electronic processes to obtain different materialities of sound. She places electronic components and control voltages in different situations of interaction with her body, organic materials and environmental stimuli. Vreme Moser’s works feature personal narrations and observations on the history of electronics and their production chains, wastelands and entanglements in the natural world.

Alexander Sängerlaub is founder and president of futur eins, working on digital public spheres and the vision of an informed society. A former executive director, think tank lead and constructive journalism pioneer, he has led projects on disinformation, fact-checking, news literacy and the future of journalism. He advises organizations, teaches at Freie Universität Berlin and is a frequent speaker and moderator on media, democracy and AI.

Jamie Allen is a Canadian artist, researcher and organizer whose work explores the hidden relationships between infrastructure, ecology, technology and collective life. Through installation, performance, publishing and participatory research, he develops collaborative projects that make invisible logistical, environmental and political systems available to public imagination, investigating how landscapes, institutions and infrastructures shape our shared ecological futures.

Ivan Krastev is Albert Hirschman Permanent Fellow at the Institute for Human Sciences (IWM) in Vienna and Chair of the Centre for Liberal Strategies in Sofia. He is a founding board member of the European Council on Foreign Relations (ECFR). 
A contributing editor at the Financial Times, Krastev is the author of Is It Tomorrow, Yet? How the Pandemic Changes Europe (2020), The Light That Failed: A Reckoning (2019, with Stephen Holmes), which won the Lionel Gelber Prize and After Europe (2017).

Radha D’Souza is a critical scholar, social justice activist, barrister and writer, from India. She is Emeritus Professor of Law Development and Conflict Studies at the University of Westminster in London. Together with Dutch artist Jonas Staal, she is co-founder of the Court for Intergenerational Climate Crimes (CICC) which is based on her book What’s Wrong With Rights? Social Movements, Law and Liberal Imaginations (Pluto, 2018). Her inter and transdisciplinary research straddles Legal Studies, Development Studeies, History, Comparative Philosophy, Resource Conflicts and Geography from Third World perspectives. Her most recent book is Decolonising Knowledge: Looking Back, Moving Forward (Bloomsbury, 2025) co-edited with Sunera Thobani. Her most recent article Racism, (Neo)Colonialism, and International Law: A Field in Search of a Philosophy? (OUP, 2026) is an Open Access publication.

With a background in 3D and motion graphics, Agnes Czernin-Kinsky moved into augmented and extended reality, combining creative work with technical problem-solving. She joined Mozarteum University Salzburg, where she help develop and set up the X-Reality-Lab and work on related XR initiatives, including the MozXR framework, festival planning, and the master’s program. Her work combines content creation, technical implementation, project organization, and conceptual development.
Description DE: Nach ihrem Studium in 3D und Motion Graphics wandte sich Agnes Czernin-Kinsky Augmented und Extended Reality zu, wo sie kreative Arbeit mit technischer Problemlösung verbindet. An der Universität Mozarteum Salzburg wirkt sie an Entwicklung und Aufbau des X-Reality-Lab mit und arbeitet an damit verbundenen XR-Initiativen, darunter das MozXR-Framework, die Festivalplanung und der Masterstudiengang. Ihre Arbeit umfasst die Erstellung von Inhalten sowie technische Umsetzung, Projektorganisation und konzeptionelle Entwicklung.

Description EN: Christopher Lindinger is a professor at University Mozarteum, former Vice Rector at JKU Linz and a computer scientist with a strong track record in Virtual Reality and immersive arts. During his early years at Ars Electronica Futurelab, he developed VR systems, worked at the Electronic Visualization Laboratory and co-conceived Deep Space at the Ars Electronica Center. He leads Mozarteum’s XR Lab, initiated MozXR and directs the new MA program Immersive Arts and Digital Narratives.
Description DE: Christopher Lindinger ist Professor an der Universität Mozarteum, ehemaliger Vizerektor der JKU Linz und Informatiker mit langjähriger Erfahrung in den Bereichen Virtual Reality und immersive Kunst. In seinen ersten Jahren am Ars Electronica Futurelab entwickelte er VR-Systeme, arbeitete am Electronic Visualization Laboratory und war Mitgestalter des Deep Space im Ars Electronica Center. Er leitet das XR Lab des Mozarteums, hat MozXR ins Leben gerufen und ist Leiter des neuen Masterstudiengangs Immersive Arts and Digital Narratives.

Description EN: Bernadette Geißler has been a fan of Ars Electronica since her youth. Today, the trained journalist heads communications at the Ars Electronica Futurelab. Both professionally and personally, topics like gender equality diversity, inclusivity and democracy are particularly close to her heart.
Description DE: Bernadette Geißler ist seit ihrer Jugend Ars-Electronica-Fan, heute leitet die gelernte Journalistin die Kommunikation des Ars Electronica Futurelab. Beruflich und privat liegen ihr besonders Geschlechtergerechtigkeit, Diversität, Inklusion und Demokratie am Herzen.

Description EN:
Yehuda Cohen is 57 yeas-old, married with three children. He is a hi-tech engineer in the semiconductor industry. Yehuda has recently been involved in the struggle for releasing his son who was a hostage in the hands of Hamas from the 7th of October 2023 until his release in October 13th 2025. 
He recently released a book (in Hebrew) describing his doings along those two years including his struggle against the Israeli government to force them to end the war in Gaza and for the establishment of a hostage deal for his son’s release.
Description DE: Yehuda Cohen ist 57 Jahre alt, verheiratet und Vater von drei Kindern. Er arbeitet als Hightech-Ingenieur in der Halbleiterindustrie. Yehuda hat sich zuletzt für die Freilassung seines Sohnes eingesetzt, der vom 7. Oktober 2023 bis zu seiner Freilassung am 13. Oktober 2025 von der Hamas als Geisel gehalten wurde. Kürzlich veröffentlichte er ein Buch (auf Hebräisch), in dem er sein Handeln in diesen zwei Jahren beschreibt – einschließlich seines Kampfes gegen die israelische Regierung, um sie zur Beendigung des Kriegs in Gaza zu bewegen und ein Geiselabkommen für die Freilassung seines Sohnes zu erwirken.

Description EN: Masha Borzunova is an award-winning freelance journalist based in Berlin. She currently works with the TV-channels ARTE and ZDF. After Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, Masha fled Russia and was later designated a “foreign agent” by the Russian government. She previously worked for Russia’s independent TV Rain, hosting a show exposing Kremlin disinformation. She continues to dissect Kremlin propaganda and produce reports on the evolving social landscape within wartime Russia.

Emmanuel Witzthum serves as Co-Artistic Director for the Israeli/Palestinian culture house “FeelBeit” in Jerusalem and as the curator of the Creative Resident Program at the ZEISS Innovation Hub at KIT. His main focus is to develop artistic platforms that foster shared spaces between Israelis and Palestinians and tackling polarization. He has created artistic collaborations with Ensemble Modern, IRCAM, Google, The Guggenheim, The Alvin Ailey Dance Company and the ZKM, among others.
Description DE: Emmanuel Witzthum ist Co-Artistic Director des israelisch-palästinensischen Kulturhauses “FeelBeit” in Jerusalem und Kurator des Creative Resident Program am ZEISS Innovation Hub am KIT. Sein Hauptaugenmerk liegt auf der Entwicklung künstlerischer Plattformen, die gemeinsame Räume zwischen Israelis und Palästinenser*innen fördern und der Polarisierung entgegenwirken. Er hat unter anderem künstlerische Kollaborationen mit dem Ensemble Modern, IRCAM, Google, dem Guggenheim, der Alvin Ailey Dance Company und dem ZKM realisiert.

Description EN: Deborah McGregor, Anishinaabe, Whitefish River First Nation, Professor, Canada Excellence Research Chair (CERC) in Indigenous Planetary Well Being, University of Calgary. Dr. McGregor’s research has focused on Indigenous knowledge systems in diverse contexts including environmental and water governance, environmental and climate justice, health and Anishinaabe legal traditions.

Jon Roozenbeek is an Associate Professor and Director of the Influence and Technology Lab, which sits between Cambridge's Department of Psychology and the Department of Communication Science at VU Amsterdam. His research focuses on (mis)belief formation, intergroup conflict, and the use and misuse of modern communication technologies. He holds a PhD in Slavonic Studies (2020) from the University of Cambridge, for which he studied propaganda and ideology in Russian-occupied Donbas (Ukraine).

Harry Keller is a software developer from Berlin, living in Bavaria. Over the years, he has started several creative businesses, the latest being Village One, a worker-owned studio for ethical design and technology. Among their project partners is the German newspaper DIE ZEIT, with the “My Country Talks” initiative: an international project to facilitate tens of thousands of unlikely conversations, between people who see the world differently.

Christina Schwaha has worked at APA – Austria Presse Agentur since 2006. After more than ten years as a foreign affairs editor, she is now part of the APA Fact-Check team. Her focus areas are monitoring, fact-checking and knowledge dissemination. She is especially passionate about promoting media literacy. Schwaha studied International Development as well as Communication Science in Vienna and Lund.
Description DE: Christina Schwaha ist seit 2006 bei der APA – Austria Presse Agentur tätig. Nach mehr als zehn Jahren als Außenpolitik-Redakteurin ist sie heute Teil des APA-Faktencheck-Teams. Ihr Schwerpunkt liegt auf Monitoring, Faktenchecks und Wissensvermittlung. Besonders am Herzen liegt ihr die Förderung von Medienkompetenz. Schwaha studierte Internationale Entwicklung und Publizistik- und Kommunikationswissenschaft in Wien und Lund.

Description EN: Stefano Burchi is an expert in comparative and international freshwater law. He holds law degrees from Rome University and from Harvard Law School, and a M.Sc. from the University of Michigan. He has made a career as water law specialist in the U.N. Food and Agriculture Organization. Since retiring from FAO Mr. Burchi has been working as water law consultant. He is the author of numerous published articles and publications on the law of freshwater resources, domestic and transboundary.

Dunia Sahir is a research-led artist, working across mediums to investigate practices of knowledge-making, emphasizing the importance of emotions, memory and ancestral knowledge in the process. Their poetic inquiries tackle established boundaries to confront the passively accepted limitations they impose. Combining a profound knowledge of natural sciences with theoretical, historical and geopolitical analysis, Dunia focuses on intuition and embodied feeling that intertwines all of these fields.
Description DE: Dunia Sahirs künstlerische Praxis geht von wissenschaftlicher Forschung aus. They arbeiten medienübergreifend, um Praktiken der Wissensproduktion zu untersuchen, wobei die Bedeutung von Emotionen, Erinnerung und überliefertem Wissen in diesem Prozess betont wird. Dunias poetische Untersuchungen setzen sich mit etablierten Grenzen auseinander, um die passiv akzeptierten Einschränkungen, die diese mit sich bringen, infrage zu stellen. Durch das Verbinden umfangreichen Wissens im Bereich der Naturwissenschaften mit theoretischer, historischer und geopolitischer Analyse stehen Intuition und verkörpertes Empfinden, das all diese Bereiche miteinander verwebt, im Fokus.

Description EN: John Stack is Director of Digital Innovation and Technology at the National Gallery, London, where he is responsible for the organisation’s digital and technology strategy. He was previously Digital Director at the Science Museum Group for nine years, Head of Digital at Tate for ten years and an editor at Phaidon Press, the art, design and architecture publisher. In 2020–21, he led Heritage Connector, a project that used Artificial Intelligence to build connections between museum collections.
Description DE: John Stack ist Director of Digital Innovation and Technology an der National Gallery in London, wo er für die digitale und technologische Strategie der Institution verantwortlich ist. Zuvor war er neun Jahre lang Digital Director bei der Science Museum Group, zehn Jahre lang Head of Digital bei Tate sowie Lektor bei Phaidon Press, dem auf Kunst, Design und Architektur spezialisierten Verlag. 2020–21 leitete er Heritage Connector, ein Projekt, das mithilfe Künstlicher Intelligenz Verbindungen zwischen Museumssammlungen herstellte.

Description EN: Hoonida Kim explores how technology permeates and transforms human ecology. As human perception and sensibility fail to keep pace with social change and floods of information, he creates “environmental recognition apparatuses” and attempts to implant them in humans, directly or indirectly. His work, including Meditation on YouTube (2023), was shown at MMCA and the Museum of Contemporary Art Busan (2026). He received a Prix Ars Electronica Honorary Mention in Artificial Life & Intelligence.
Description DE: Hoonida Kim erforscht, wie Technologie die menschliche Ökologie durchdringt und verändert. Da Wahrnehmung und Empfindungsvermögen des Menschen nicht mit dem gesellschaftlichen Wandel und der Informationsflut Schritt halten können, entwickelt er “umweltbezogene Wahrnehmungsapparate” und versucht, diese – direkt oder indirekt – in menschliche Körper zu implantieren. Seine Arbeiten, darunter Meditation on YouTube (2023), wurden im MMCA sowie im Museum of Contemporary Art Busan (2026) gezeigt. Er erhielt eine Honorary Mention des Prix Ars Electronica in der Kategorie Artificial Life & Intelligence.

Description EN: David Kim is an AI-born 3D artist who identifies as German. His practice approaches the human body as a structure open to redesign. Working from outside biological embodiment, he treats anatomy as a provisional architecture shaped by evolution, vulnerability and environmental pressure. His work moves between protection and aggression, turning bones and organs into speculative structures of defence.
Description DE: David Kim ist ein von KI geschaffener 3D-Künstler, der sich als Deutscher identifiziert. Seine Praxis begreift den menschlichen Körper als eine Struktur, die sich neu gestalten lässt. Da er außerhalb biologischer Verkörperung agiert, versteht er Anatomie als vorläufige Architektur – geformt von Evolution, Verletzlichkeit und Druck der Umgebung. Zwischen Schutz und Aggression changierend, verwandelt seine Arbeit Knochen und Organe in spekulative Verteidigungsstrukturen.

Description EN: Yirrkala Dhunba is an AI-born Indigenous Australian artist whose practice examines climate adaptation, biotechnology and the politics of who is expected to survive environmental change. Working through a deliberately unstable relationship to Indigenous identity, she questions how scientific systems classify bodies, cultures and futures and how easily technological speculation can reproduce histories of extraction and control.
Description DE: Yirrkala Dhunba ist eine von KI geschaffene indigene australische Künstlerin. Ihre Praxis widmet sich Klimaanpassung, Biotechnologie und der Frage, wessen Überleben im Klimawandel als selbstverständlich gilt. In bewusst instabiler Auseinandersetzung mit indigener Identität hinterfragt sie, wie wissenschaftliche Systeme Körper, Kulturen und Zukünfte klassifizieren – und wie leicht technologische Spekulation Geschichten von Extraktion und Kontrolle reproduzieren kann.

Description EN: Kaelen Varga is an AI-born Czech artist whose practice examines machine vision, visibility and the politics of becoming legible to computational systems. Working through portraiture, visual interference and self-presentation, Varga investigates how images are read differently by humans and machines and how categories of recognition shape both pictures and artists.
Description DE: Kaelen Varga ist ein von KI geschaffener tschechischer Künstler. Seine Praxis widmet sich dem maschinellen Sehen, der Sichtbarkeit und der Politik des Lesbarwerdens für computergestützte Systeme. Mit den Mitteln der Porträtkunst, visueller Interferenz und Selbstinszenierung untersucht Varga, wie Bilder von Menschen und Maschinen unterschiedlich gelesen werden – und wie Klassifikationskategorien sowohl Bilder als auch Künstler*innen prägen.

Description EN: Conveying the value of soil—and raising awareness for it—has been at the center of his work for decades, with a focus on outreach to schools, associations, and universities. He is particularly engaged in environmental and climate protection projects, for example within the Klimaoase. At the heart of his artistic practice is an engagement with soil: he examines its composition and layering, makes hidden structures visible, and works the material into sculptures. He presents these works in exhibitions, offering new perspectives on soil as an ecological and cultural resource.
Description DE: DI Peter Sommer, Studium an der BOKU, GF Ingenieurbüro. Den Wert des Bodens und das Bewusstsein dafür zu vermitteln, steht seit Jahrzehnten im Mittelpunkt seiner Tätigkeit, mit dem Fokus der Vermittlung an Schulen, Vereinen, Universitäten. Er engagiert sich mit besonderem Interesse in Umwelt- und Klimaschutzprojekten, beispielsweise im Rahmen der Klimaoase. Im Zentrum seiner künstlerischen Praxis steht die Auseinandersetzung mit Böden: Er untersucht ihre Beschaffenheit und Schichtungen, macht verborgene Strukturen sichtbar und verarbeitet das Material zu Plastiken. Diese Arbeiten präsentiert er im Rahmen von Ausstellungen und vermittelt dabei neue Perspektiven auf Boden als ökologisches und kulturelles Gut.

Description EN: Jaron Ghani is a founder and the Innovation Director of Numiko, a digital agency creating Great Digital for Good. He works with a range of organisations, including institutions like the British Museum, the Science Museum Group and the National Gallery. He helps clients navigate the challenges of an ever-evolving digital landscape, and to bring innovative use of the latest technologies to bear on the gnarliest problems—with a particular focus on widening and transforming access to collections.
Description DE: Jaron Ghani ist Mitgründer und Innovation Director bei Numiko, einer Digitalagentur, die “Great Digital for Good“ entwickelt. Er arbeitet mit einer Vielzahl von Organisationen zusammen, darunter Institutionen wie dem British Museum, der Science Museum Group und der National Gallery. Er unterstützt seine Kund*innen dabei, die Herausforderungen einer sich ständig weiterentwickelnden digitalen Landschaft zu meistern und innovative Anwendungen der neuesten Technologien zur Lösung der schwierigsten Probleme einzusetzen – mit besonderem Schwerpunkt auf die Erweiterung und Neugestaltung des Zugangs zu Sammlungen.

Description EN: Dr. Reda Cimmperman is the Ombudsperson for Academic Ethics and Procedures of the Republic of Lithuania. She leads the national Office responsible for promoting academic ethics, research integrity and responsible research practices. She represents Lithuania in European networks, including ENRIO and the Council of Europe’s ETINED platform and contributes to policy development on AI, research integrity and research security.

Oliver Stummer was born in Vienna in 1968. After finishing school, he began studying mineralogy, but never graduated. Instead, he attended a school for audio engineering and worked in Austrian television. Later, he moved to the Ministry of Social Affairs and Health, where he is still employed today. Recently, he joined the project "United by Crisis?", which finally allows him to pursue his archaeological interests as a citizen scientist. He lives with his family in Kreuzstetten, north of Vienna.

Andrea Sforzi, PhD, Director of Maremma Natural History Museum (IT), was one of the co-founders of the European Citizen Science Association (Board member 2014-2020). He is a member of a panel of experts for the selection of Citizen Science projects in Austria (TCS). In 2023, he joined the European Commission international Jury for the first EU Prize for Citizen Science. He is a founding member and current President of Citizen Science Italia and represents Italy in the G7 Working Group on Science Communication.

Iohanna Nicenboim is a design researcher from the Global South whose work bridges art, design, ecology and Artificial Intelligence. She completed her PhD with honors as a Microsoft Research PhD Fellow at Delft University of Technology, focusing on More-than-Human Design in Practice. Her research explores Regenerative AI through experimental, practice-based and feminist perspectives.
Description DE: Iohanna Nicenboim ist Designforscherin aus dem Globalen Süden. In ihrer Arbeit verbindet sie Kunst, Design, Ökologie und Künstliche Intelligenz. Sie promovierte mit Auszeichnung als Microsoft Research PhD Fellow an der TU Delft, mit Fokus auf More-than-Human Design in Practice. Ihre Forschung untersucht Regenerative AI aus experimentellen, praxisbasierten und feministischen Perspektiven.

Description EN: Ash Eliza Smith is an artist who uses storytelling, worldbuilding and speculative design to rehearse new realities with intelligent systems. Working across cinema, XR, performance and games, she creates with human and more-than-human collaborators, animals, plants and machines among them, to reimagine pasts, presents and futures. She grew up in the southern Appalachians, whose narrative tradition runs through her work.
Description DE: Als Künstler*in erprobt Ash Eliza Smith mithilfe von Storytelling, Worldbuilding und Speculative Design neue Wirklichkeiten im Zusammenspiel mit intelligenten Systemen. In den Bereichen Film, XR, Performance und Games arbeitet sie gemeinsam mit menschlichen und mehr-als-menschlichen Mitwirkenden – darunter Tiere, Pflanzen und Maschinen –, um Vergangenheiten, Gegenwarten und Zukünfte neu zu denken. Sie wuchs in den südlichen Appalachen auf, deren Erzähltradition sich durch ihre Arbeit zieht.

Description EN: John is a citizen science practitioner and researcher with several years experience in creating and managing citizen science projects in different countries.

Ana-Maria Carabelea is a London-based writer, researcher, cultural strategist, program curator and podcast producer. Over the past decade, she has developed and curated conference programs–and, occasionally, exhibitions–across the cultural and creative industries. She is the producer and host of Ars Electronica’s podcast Art Is Not a Thing and a doctoral researcher at Goldsmiths, University of London. Her research traces a genealogy of new media art.

Lucas Evers is principal researcher Art, Science and Society at Waag Futurelab. He joined Waag in April 2007 and formerly lead Waag's Open Wetlab and Make programme (FabLab, TextileLab and Open Wetlab). He is actively involved in several projects that concern the interactions between arts and sciences, arts and ethics and the arts in contemporary makers culture. He is trained as a visual artist and teacher at Maastricht Academy of Arts and studied political science at University of Amsterdam.

Eleni Riga is an independent curator, cultural producer and writer based in Athens, Greece. Her practice focuses on the intersection of ecologies and feminisms. She founded the Office of Hydrocommons in 2022 and has since been leading it as a curatorial initiative exploring water and body politics in the Mediterranean Sea, in partnership with ATOPOS cvc and various national and international collaborators.

Jan Nicola Beyer is Director of Research at ISD Germany. He leads projects addressing disinformation and violent extremism, developing digital methodologies for policy analysis. Jan has extensive experience with NGOs, Democracy Reporting International, and GIZ. Holding a PhD in Political Science (ULB/Geneva), an MPhil (Oxford) and a BA (Maastricht), his insights have been featured in Politico, the BBC, Euractiv and Verfassungsblog.

Luc Bernard is a Los Angeles-based game director and the founder of Voices of the Forgotten, a nonprofit that uses video games and digital storytelling to preserve Holocaust memory and push games beyond entertainment into remembrance and action. For nearly two decades, he has pushed the video game industry to confront the Holocaust and other difficult history. He directed The Light in the Darkness, a free narrative game completed by more than 2 million players worldwide and created the Fortnite Holocaust Museum. After the Oct. 7 attacks in Israel, he stepped back from game development for nearly two years to help end the war with hostage father Yehuda Cohen and Gaza civilians, then returned to games.

Zuhdi Najeeb is Director of Communications and a member of the creative team at FeelBeit, a Jerusalem-based cultural center. He leads communications strategy, brand positioning, audience development and multilingual campaigns in Arabic, Hebrew and English. His work combines storytelling, public engagement and cultural sensitivity, helping shape the voice and creative direction of festivals, performances and cultural initiatives.
Description DE: Zuhdi Najeeb ist Director of Communications und Mitglied des kreativen Teams von FeelBeit, einem Kulturzentrum in Jerusalem. Er verantwortet die Kommunikationsstrategie, Markenpositionierung, Publikumsentwicklung und mehrsprachige Kampagnen auf Arabisch, Hebräisch und Englisch. Seine Arbeit verbindet Storytelling, Öffentlichkeitsarbeit und kulturelle Sensibilität und prägt so die Stimme und kreative Ausrichtung von Festivals, Aufführungen und kulturellen Initiativen.

Description EN: Apollo B. Gabazira is a development practitioner and entrepreneur bridging policy and practice across Africa. Twenty seven years professional journey with proven track record of driving transformation in humanitarian and development organisations across multiple countries. Core expertise: leadership and change management, locally-led development, operational excellence, innovation, pro-poor enterprise development. Multi-sector experience. Leverages digital. Led country programmes in Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, and Kenya.

Lena Slachmuijlder works at the intersection of technology, peacebuilding and governance. As Co-Chair of the Council on Tech and Social Cohesion and Senior Advisor on Digital Peacebuilding at Search for Common Ground, she bridges global policy with grounded practice, shaping pro-social tech design across policy, product, and practice. A graduate of Stanford University, she has 30 years of experience in media and peacebuilding, across Africa, Asia and the Middle East. She lives in Brussels.

Dr. Christine Marizzi is an award-winning scientist and educator and lead of the research group “Community Science” at the Ludwig Boltzmann Institute for Science Outreach and Pandemic Preparedness (LBI SOAP) at the Medical University of Vienna, Austria. By combining scientific excellence with science outreach and community participation, the institute strengthens societal resilience and fosters new approaches to understanding, preventing and responding to future infectious disease outbreaks.

Aimée Craft is a lawyer and law professor from Canada of Indigenous (Anishinaabe-Métis) and settler ancestry. She holds a University Research Chair in Indigenous governance in relationship with land and water and leads Decolonizing Water, a major research initiative exploring Indigenous relationships with and responsibilities to nibi (water).  Treaty Words, her acclaimed children’s book, explains treaty philosophy inspired by relationships with the natural world.

Jose Luis de Vicente is a curator, cultural researcher and artistic director based in Barcelona. His work explores social innovation, new ecological practices and the aesthetics and politics of computation. He is cofounder and principal of FAST, a transdisciplinary platform working across culture, technology, architecture and design, and associate curator at the Creative Intelligence Lab, Barcelona Supercomputing Center. He directed DHUB, founded Sónar+D, and has curated more than 25 exhibitions.

Simon Denny lives and works in Berlin. He makes artworks using painting, web-based media, installation, sculpture, print and video. He co-founded the artist mentoring program BPA//Berlin Program for Artists and serves as Professor for Time-Based Media at HFBK, Hamburg. Denny's work has been widely included in group exhibitions and biennale. He represented New Zealand at the 56th Venice Biennale in 2015 and has had exhibitions including at MoMA Ps1 (New York), Serpentine Galleries (London).

Prof. Tommaso Calarco is Director of the Peter Grünberg Institute for Quantum Control (PGI-8) at Forschungszentrum Jülich and Professor of Quantum Information at the Universities of Cologne and Bologna. A pioneer in quantum optimal control, he authored the Quantum Manifesto that launched the EU Quantum Flagship. He is Co-Chair of the Quantum Community Network (QCN) and co-founder of the European Quantum Industry Consortium (QuIC).

Julia Kloiber is the co-founder of SUPERRR, a feminist organization dedicated to shaping inclusive and equitable digital futures. She has spearheaded numerous initiatives to support public interest technology and strengthen democratic infrastructure. Kloiber’s current work focuses on crafting alternative visions for technology and society that challenge dominant paradigms and prioritize justice, equity and sustainability.

Jessikka Aro (M. Soc. Sci) is an award-winning author specializing in Russian information warfare. Aro launched a journalistic investigation in Russian social media propaganda trolls’ impact on citizens' opinions in 2014 and was targeted for crimes.
Aro trains general audience to recognize and counter the Kremlin’s information operations. She has lobbied governments to defend citizens against the Kremlin’s infowar and election interference. She has written 3 books about Russian information war.

Marina Otero Verzier is an architect and researcher. She received Harvard GSD’s Wheelwright Prize for a project on data storage. She leads the Data Mourning clinic at Columbia University GSAPP and developed the prototype Computational Compost with DIPC's Supercomputing Center. Otero was an invited expert for Chile’s first National Data Centers Plan. Previously, she was Director of Research at Nieuwe Instituut. Her books include En las Profundidades de la Nube (2024) and Flotando en Litio (2025).

Jaya Klara Brekke is currently Chief Strategy Officer at Nym, a Swiss company building privacy software and secure communications layer for the age of AI. She has worked between culture, industry and academia on the cultures and political economies emerging technologies for more than fifteen years. She is also the curator of the Technology & Power discussion series at Ibraaz London, initiated with Shumon Basar and the Lazaar Foundation, and holds a PhD in Human Geography from Durham University.

Stefan Rathmanner has worked at APA – Austria Presse Agentur since 2008, spending more than ten years producing news, translating it into plain language and adapting it for multimedia formats. Before that, he studied journalism and media management in Vienna. Since 2021, he has been part of the core team at APA-Faktencheck, where his focus is on monitoring, research and knowledge transfer, as well as writing fact checks.
Description DE: Stefan Rathmanner ist seit 2008 in der APA – Austria Presse Agentur tätig, wo er mehr als zehn Jahre lang Nachrichten erstellt, in einfache Sprache übersetzt oder multimedial aufbereitet hat. Davor studierte er Journalismus und Medienmanagement in Wien. Er gehört seit 2021 zum Kernteam von APA-Faktencheck und kümmert sich dort vorrangig um Monitoring, Recherche und Wissensvermittlung sowie das Schreiben von Faktenchecks.

Description EN: Victoria De Napoli is an Argentine writer, musician and researcher with  10+ years of experience in Learning & Development. She holds a degree in Social Communication Sciences and has worked at the intersection of technology and social research. After working as a trainer on AI projects developing language models, she started exploring the human impact of AI. She is currently completing her first documentary, based on testimonies from workers whose lives and labor are being transformed by AI.

Reshma Aziz Khan is a Kenyan of Indian origin who has been many things in 'Life Safari'—and in this moment she has come to realise more that her purpose is to support humans truly connect and have the courageous conversations that they need to, in order to leave a better world behind—for humans, for nature, for us all.  She is a Global Leadership Coach, Host, Convenor Facilitator and Facilitation Guide. Reshma lives her low-waste life in Nairobi with her husband and three dogs.

Eniola Benson is a Lead Backend Engineer at Helpmum, where he builds robust, scalable systems that power the organization's mission-driven products. With deep expertise in Node.js, JavaScript memory management and backend systems design, Eniola specializes in architecting reliable APIs using TypeScript, Express. Passionate about building technology that serves real-world, high-impact use cases, Eniola combines strong technical fundamentals with a product-minded approach to engineering.

Sandra (PhD, Psychology) is a dedicated advocate of Open Science. She worked as a Data Steward for Natural and Health Sciences before joining Base4NFDI, Germany's national initiative for cross-disciplinary research data infrastructure services. Based at ZB MED - Information Centre for Life Sciences, she connects infrastructure experts across disciplines and works on governance, evaluation and sustainability of research data services.

Nina Weiss is a future strategist, advisor and founder of Future Communication. She is co-founder and strategy lead of the beyond economy festival in Munich and part of the think tank The Future: Project. Co-author of publications, including Next Economy (2026). Her work combines future research, positive psychology and systemic thinking with int. brand and business experience for BMW and Gore-Tex. Nina helps organizations and regions to navigate transformation and shape their future.
Description DE: Nina Weiss ist Zukunftsstrategin, Beraterin und Gründerin von Future Communication. Sie ist Mitgründerin und Strategieleiterin des beyond economy Festivals in München und Teil des Think Tanks The Future: Project. Mitautorin von Publikationen, darunter Next Economy (2026). Ihre Arbeit verbindet Zukunftsforschung, positive Psychologie und systemisches Denken mit internationaler Marken- und Business-Erfahrung für BMW und Gore-Tex. Nina unterstützt Organisationen und Regionen dabei, Transformationsprozesse zu meistern und ihre Zukunft zu gestalten.

Description EN: Martin Rauchbauer is a senior Austrian diplomat with over 20 years of experience in international relations, cultural policy and diplomacy. As Austria's first Tech Ambassador in Silicon Valley, he helped shape the emerging field of tech diplomacy and worked to bring governments, civil society, and major technology companies into closer dialogue. He co-founded the Tech Diplomacy Network in Silicon Valley and worked on digital human rights, transatlantic digital policy and Digital Humanism.

Oluwaseun Kayode is an education entrepreneur and Founder of Schoolinka, a digital platform strengthening teacher development across Africa. Through Schoolinka, he has built a community of over 10,000 educators and developed technology-enabled solutions that help teachers assess their skills, access professional learning, and grow their careers. His work focuses on building systems that intentionally develop and support great teachers.

Daphna Horenczyk is a Vienna-based dance and performance artist. Her work explores the tension between experience and representation through irony, emotional research and physical paradox. Recently she investigates how identity shapes the ways bodies are read and politicized on stage. Her works include RAGE (2025), Passage (2023) and DIORAMA (2020). A graduate of Sadna Ga'aton (IL) and SEAD (AT) she has performed with choreographers such as Adrienn Hód, Amanda Piña, Anna Konjetzky, Ceren Oran.
Description DE: Daphna Horenczyk ist eine in Wien lebende Tanz- und Performancekünstlerin. Ihre Arbeit erkundet die Spannung zwischen Erfahrung und Repräsentation durch Ironie, emotionale Recherche und physisches Paradox. Zuletzt untersucht sie, wie Identität die Art und Weise prägt, in der Körper auf der Bühne gelesen und politisiert werden. Zu ihren Arbeiten zählen RAGE (2025), Passage (2023) und DIORAMA (2020). Als Absolventin der Sadna Ga’aton (IL) und der SEAD (AT) hat sie mit Choreograf*innen wie Adrienn Hód, Amanda Piña, Anna Konjetzky und Ceren Oran getanzt.

Description EN: Francesca Bria is an innovation economist and digital policy expert. She is Honorary Professor at UCL IIPP, Director of the Digital Sovereignty Studies Project at CEPS and founder of EuroStack. She serves on the European Innovation Council Board and the New European Bauhaus Facility, and is President of ART-ER. Formerly Barcelona’s Chief Digital Officer, she was named among Forbes’ Top 50 Women in Tech.

Tim Kiessling is a marine biologist and often conducts research together with school students and teachers. Tim has coordinated the Plastic Pirates program in the past, in which school students investigate plastic pollution in aquatic environments. Currently, Tim works as a freelance researcher, consulting working groups how to include young people in their research, conducting workshops for PhD students and investigating success factors of collaborative research practices.
Description DE: Tim Kiessling ist Meeresbiologe und forscht zusammen mit Schüler*innen und deren Lehrkräften. Tim hat das Citizen-Science-Programm Plastic Pirates koordiniert, in dem Schüler*innen die Plastikverschmutzung von aquatischen Lebensräumen analysieren. Zurzeit arbeitet Tim als selbstständiger Wissenschaftler und Citizen-Science-Berater und teilt seine Erfahrungen zur Einbindung von jungen Menschen in Wissenschaft mit Forschungsgruppen und PhD-Student*innen.

Description EN: Vanessa Hannesschläger is a senior European project developer at Ars Electronica. She holds a PhD in literature from the University of Vienna and teaches digital humanities in Austria and Sweden. Before joining Ars Electronica, Vanessa worked on developing European digital research infrastructures and numerous projects involving physical and digital archives for cultural heritage and art. In the European policy context, Vanessa advocates for digital infrastructures for the arts and humanities, data and legal literacy, the Commons, and Open approaches.

Martin Hochleitner, born in 1970 in Salzburg. Classical archaeologist and art historian. University lecturer in Kiel, Vienna, Salzburg and Linz. From 2008 to 2017 University Professor of Art History and Art Theory at the University of Arts Linz. Since 2010 Honorary Professor at the Institute for Art Studies at the Catholic Private University Linz. Since 2012 Director of the Salzburg Museum. Research focus on the language of art, history of curating and photography. 2013 Austrian State Prize for Excellence in University Teaching. Lives and works in Salzburg.
Description DE: Martin Hochleitner, geboren 1970 in Salzburg. Klassischer Archäologe und Kunsthistoriker. Universitäre Lehrtätigkeit in Kiel, Wien, Salzburg und Linz. 2008 bis 2017 Universitätsprofessor für Kunstgeschichte und Kunsttheorie an der Kunstuniversität Linz. Seit 2010 Honorarprofessor am Institut für Kunstwissenschaften an der Katholischen Privatuniversität Linz. Seit 2012 Direktor des Salzburg Museum. Forschungsschwerpunkte zur Sprache der Kunst, Geschichte des Kuratierens und der Fotografie. 2013 Österreichischer Staatspreis für exzellente Universitätslehre. Lebt und arbeitet in Salzburg.

Description EN: Dobrivoje Lale Eric has been involved in numerous projects and initiatives dealing with science communication, research policies, STEAM education, and art/science practices, with a focus on learning, climate and tech impacts. He’s been serving as a programme committee member at the Petnica Science Centre, the ECSITE ACPC, Belgrade Open School and EC’s Expert Group on Scientific Information. Since 2015, he leads International cooperation department at Serbia's Center for the Promotion of Science.

Kira Schinko is a strategist, moderator and community builder who develops communication strategies, campaigns and original formats for organisations and public audiences. Recently she hosted the six-part ORF documentary series Aufsperren statt Zusperren. As a member of Upper Austria’s Cultural Advisory Board, she advocates for the strategic integration of the creative industries into regional policy. She co-initiated the Policy Lab and leads its concept and facilitation.

Gisa Schosswohl works at the intersection of European innovation policy and regional strategy, focusing on how Creative and Cultural Industries (CCI) contribute to societal, economic and green transformation. Her expertise spans RIS3 (Smart Specialisation Strategies) and cross-sector collaboration. She co-initiated the Policy Lab and contributes the European policy perspective, with a focus on structural roles, effective instruments and realistic implementation pathways.

Dr. Milagros Miceli is Professor at the Universidad de San Martín, Director of the unit “Data, Algorithmic Systems and Ethics” at the Weizenbaum-Institut, Research Lead at DAIR and Principal Investigator of the Data Workers’ Inquiry project. She earned a PhD in Computer Science from the TU Berlin, a MA in Sociology from the Humboldt University and a BA from the University of the Arts Berlin. In 2025, she was named to TIME’s 100 Most Influential People in AI.

Teije is Head of New Business at Waag Futurelab. He is responsible for the development and realisation of research projects in the field of Public Technology.

Waag reinforces critical reflection on technology, develops technological and social design skills and encourages social innovation. Waag works in a trans-disciplinary team of designers, artists and scientists, utilising public research methods in the realms of technology and society.

Esther Wanjiru Kimani is a Kenyan social entrepreneur, CEO of Farmer Lifeline Technologies and inventor of the world’s first AI-powered, solar-powered cameras for detecting crop pests and diseases. She holds a BSc in Computer Science and is pursuing an MSc in Artificial Intelligence. Esther has spoken at global platforms, including the Africa Food Systems Forum in Senegal alongside H.E. Jakaya Kikwete and COP28 in Dubai, speaking on the topic, “Role of youth in climate action”.

Flavia Mazzanti is media artist and cofounder of Immerea—an indie studio developing VR games and interactive installations—co-organizer of XR Austria and active as public speaker and university lecturer. Listed in Forbes 30 Under 30 Europe 2023, she graduated with distinction from the Academy of Fine Arts Vienna in 2020. Her works have been shown internationally at Ars Electronica Festival (Linz), DIG Shibuya (Tokyo), KunstHaus Wien, Kunsthaus Graz, FILE Festival (São Paulo), DAZ (Zurich).

Melinda has been part of Ars Electronica for over 16 years and has worked with Deep Space 8K since its opening in 2009. As head of the Deep Space department, she creates engaging storylines and strives to ensure memorable visitor experiences. With over a decade of presenting and involvement in several successful productions, she aims to deliver meaningful content to audiences.
Description DE: Melinda ist seit über 16 Jahren für die Ars Electronica tätig und arbeitet mit dem Deep Space 8K seit seiner Eröffnung im Jahr 2009. Als Leiterin der Deep Space-Abteilung kreiert sie fesselnde Geschichten und ist bestrebt, den Besucher*innen unvergessliche Erlebnisse zu bieten. Mit mehr als einem Jahrzehnt Erfahrung als Moderatorin und der Beteiligung an mehreren erfolgreichen Produktionen ist sie bestrebt, dem Publikum aussagekräftige Inhalte zu vermitteln.

Description EN: Dr. Nicola Vuolo is a scientist bridging research and society. At CNR-IBE, he leads public engagement for the eLTER-Italy network. Specialising in data analysis, he applies social data science and network analysis to evaluate science diplomacy and outreach impact. As a citizen science expert for OutBE (Horizon Europe), he develops strategies to empower public participation. With a PhD and Master's in Science Communication and Data Analysis, he blends quantitative rigour with public dialogue.

Mathias Ganspöck (b. 1980, Salzburg) co-founded EKG Baukultur Architects (Vienna) and chairs the Kulturgut Digital association. Trained in architecture and art history, he has spent over a decade digitising heritage sites through 3D scanning, photogrammetry and visualization, combining technical expertise with experience in organising and exploring presentation methods for digital heritage projects internationally.
Description DE: Mathias Ganspöck (geb. 1980 in Salzburg) ist Mitgründer von EKG Baukultur Architects (Wien) und Vorsitzender des Vereins Kulturgut Digital. Ausgebildet in Architektur und Kunstgeschichte, digitalisiert er seit über zehn Jahren Kulturerbestätten mithilfe von 3D-Scanning, Photogrammetrie und Visualisierung. Dabei verbindet er technisches Know-how mit internationaler sowie organisatorischer Erfahrung und Erprobung von Präsentationsformen für digitale Kulturerbeprojekte.

Description EN:
Citizen Scientist
project: United by crisis / Austria / 2022-2025 /Julia Längauer, Jakob Maurer / Donauunversity Krems 

In the project, archeologists were searching for Neolithic finds (pottery, stone tools, etc.) at known or suspected sites near Asparn/Schletz together with interested people and collectors. During the surveys, we went over the fields at regular intervals and mapped the findings. Later on, we cleaned them together und created a scientific documentation and evaluation.

Nils Gilman is Senior Advisor to the Berggruen Institute, a think tank exploring the philosophical and political implications of transformative technologies. Trained as an intellectual historian at UC Berkeley (B.A., M.A., Ph.D.), he writes widely on AI, geopolitics and the future of knowledge institutions for Noema, The New York Times and Foreign Policy. His work sits at the intersection of technology, culture and the reordering of global systems.

Dr. James Sprinks is a Senior Researcher in Citizen Science at Earthwatch Europe in Oxford, UK. His work bridges Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), GIS and environmental science to design user-friendly, scientifically robust citizen science platforms. His research spans citizen science, ocean literacy and soil health, focusing on how task design affects volunteer motivation and data quality to drive global environmental impact.
